About Portugal Textile Hub

Portugal Textile Hub helps international brands build, manage and scale textile manufacturing capabilities in Portugal and Morocco.

We combine sourcing expertise, production supervision and strategic supply chain design to create resilient, scalable and commercially disciplined production ecosystems. Our role is simple: reduce complexity, improve visibility and help brands focus on growth while manufacturing remains under control.

⌖

Factory matching, supplier alignment and production route definition based on category, quantity, timing and target positioning.

◇

Development follow-up, production checkpoints, timeline visibility and quality oversight throughout the manufacturing process.

▥

Supply Chain Design

Portugal-first capability, with Morocco scalability when programs require larger volumes, cost efficiency or capacity diversification.

How We Work

Flexible manufacturing partnerships. Designed around your needs. We start with the project, then define the cooperation model, partner structure and level of local support that best fits the client.

1

Understand

We clarify the product, category, volumes, target price, quality expectations, timelines and commercial priorities.

2

Design

We define the most suitable cooperation model around project complexity, required involvement and operational needs.

3

Select

We evaluate partners by capability, quality level, pricing, MOQs, lead times, payment terms and strategic fit.

4

Align

We support negotiation and align expectations, responsibilities and commercial terms before development or production begins.

5

Support

We act as your team on the ground, following communication, development, production milestones and execution control.

6

Scale

When the model is validated, we help expand capacity through the most suitable Portugal and Morocco manufacturing routes.

Flexible Cooperation Models

Direct Manufacturing Partnerships

Clients contract directly with selected manufacturing partners while Portugal Textile Hub supports sourcing, negotiation, alignment and execution visibility.

Managed Sourcing

We coordinate supplier selection, development follow-up and production supervision while maintaining clear visibility between brand and factory.

Fully Managed Projects

For selected projects, Portugal Textile Hub can manage the execution process through a single point of contact, adapting communication and involvement to the client.

Portugal and Morocco create a powerful textile outsourcing corridor: close to Europe, connected to global markets and positioned for speed, flexibility and competitive execution.
